summary.en: A music gallery and player for the Japanese electronic duo Nanatsukaze.
summary.zh: 为日本电子音乐组合 Nanatsukaze 制作的音乐画廊与播放器。

caption.en: Local capture of the public source. Playback and thumbnails depend on YouTube availability.
caption.zh: 公开源码的本地截图。播放与缩略图依赖 YouTube 的可用性。

features.en: Browse songs and search by title or artist.
features.zh: 浏览歌曲，按歌名或艺人搜索。

features.en: Play, pause, seek, shuffle, and repeat through the YouTube player.
features.zh: 通过 YouTube 播放器播放、暂停、跳转、随机及循环播放。
支持键盘操作与减少动态效果设置。

notes.en: Embedding a player separates the interface from media delivery. Unavailable videos need an explicit recovery path.
notes.zh: 嵌入播放器将界面与媒体传输分离。不可用的视频需要明确的恢复机制。

notes.en: Animated interfaces need reduced-motion options and smaller-screen performance limits.
notes.zh: 动画界面需要减少动态效果选项，以及适合小屏幕的性能限制。

scope.en: The repository describes a live release. This does not establish a maintenance commitment or guarantee that every video remains available.
scope.zh: 仓库标记为已上线。这不代表维护承诺，也不保证所有视频持续可用。

summary.en: A Modern Campus workspace for a school coding community.
summary.zh: 面向校园编程社团的 Modern Campus 工作空间。

caption.en: MicroHub dashboard from its UI checks, with synthetic test data.
caption.zh: MicroHub 界面测试中的仪表盘，使用虚构测试数据。

features.en: Membership onboarding, profiles, and a member directory.
features.zh: 会员入会、个人资料与成员目录。
根据角色提供会员审批与管理功能。

features.en: Consistent layouts for phones and tablets.
features.zh: 适配手机和平板的一致布局。

notes.en: Shared design tokens keep forms, cards, navigation, and feedback consistent across screens.
notes.zh: 共享设计变量让表单、卡片、导航与反馈在不同页面保持一致。

notes.en: A useful dashboard should distinguish available workflows from planned modules.
notes.zh: 实用的仪表盘应明确区分可用流程与计划中的模块。

scope.en: Homework, attendance, and event modules are planned. The screenshot is a UI preview, not a live school account.
scope.zh: 作业、考勤与活动模块仍在规划中。截图为界面预览，并非真实学校账号。

summary.en: A Japanese learning space with guided lessons, focused practice, and personal progress.
summary.zh: 通过引导课程、专注练习与个人进度记录学习日语。

caption.en: Local capture of the public landing page; no signed-in account or learning records.
caption.zh: 公开介绍页面的本地截图，不含已登录账号或学习记录。

features.en: A structured learning path with kana and lesson practice.
features.zh: 结构化学习路径，提供假名与课程练习。

features.en: Daily practice and review of previous mistakes.
Listening tools and account-based progress tracking.
features.zh: 听力工具与基于账号的进度追踪。

notes.en: Study history and practice drafts need clear ownership so one account never inherits another account’s progress.
notes.zh: 学习历史与练习草稿需要明确归属，避免账号间进度混淆。

notes.en: A polished learning interface still needs content, accessibility, and authenticated-flow acceptance checks.
notes.zh: 完善的学习界面仍需要内容、无障碍与登录流程的验收。

scope.en: The project documentation lists remaining release checks. This portfolio links to the source rather than exposing an authenticated learning workspace.
scope.zh: 项目文档仍列有待完成的发布检查。此处提供源码链接，不展示已登录的学习空间。

summary.en: A personal portfolio built around useful project discovery and the Modern Campus design language.
summary.zh: 围绕实用的项目探索与 Modern Campus 设计语言构建的个人作品集。

caption.en: Local portfolio preview. Featured fallback data is clearly labeled when GitHub is unavailable.
caption.zh: 作品集本地预览。GitHub 不可用时，精选备用数据会明确标注。

features.en: Search, language and status filters, bookmarks, and shareable URLs.
features.zh: 搜索、语言与状态筛选、收藏和可分享的网址。

features.en: English and Chinese, persistent preferences, and light/dark themes.
features.zh: 中英文切换、偏好记忆与明暗主题。

features.en: Cached repository data, optimized local images, and automated browser checks.
features.zh: 仓库数据缓存、优化的本地图片与自动化浏览器检查。

notes.en: A network request should enhance a useful page. Cached and curated content keep project discovery available when the API fails.
notes.zh: 网络请求应增强已有页面；缓存与精选内容可在 API 失败时继续支持项目探索。

notes.en: Search state belongs in the URL when visitors need to share or restore the same collection.
notes.zh: 当访客需要分享或恢复同一组结果时，搜索状态应保存在网址中。

scope.en: This redesign is being developed locally. Publication is a separate deployment step.
scope.zh: 此改版正在本地开发中，正式上线需要单独部署。
